question: Early on, a Team ES2008 member asked whether the remote should only have buttons for the television. Who said they would look into it, and what answer was reported back?
answer: Speaker A (Project Manager) said they would look into it; the answer reported back in meeting b was that the remote would be just for television, not video or other devices. [ES2008a] [ES2008b]
